observations.why: Present-tense 'we're switching' performs the migration as already underway — a settled, load-bearing commitment, not a proposal being argued.
Flat unhedged assertions offered as justification for the switch — asserted and ready to defend, but no ratification or operational language; moveable with evidence.
Arrow notation records the migration as a settled transition, ratifying the decision in summary form.
Unhedged performance claim restated as a summary point — asserted as fact but without ratification or operational commitment language.
A fixed timeline attached to the migration acts as an operational commitment — the speaker expects others to schedule around it.
